title: Anyone else
content: Hi, Last night I dreamed that the mall had a hidden sub-level that led me outside to an open-air market. It wasn’t like the regular mall shops like there were whole sections dedicated to things like tarot readers, psychics, crystal jewelry, and paintings. When I walked past the market and off the mall’s property, I suddenly found myself standing in front of an old, rusty train station. Has anyone else had a dream similar to mine?
